## WF-Plan — Plan Period (fb-plan-period)
On-demand only. The Dashboard 'Plan next N days' button (executive-gated) POSTs { start_date, days } with the `x-webhook-secret: __N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET__` header (n8n redacts Authorization).

plan long / generate short: one cheap Anthropic call drafts the SCHEDULE only — no copy/images. Build Plan Request reads active subtopics + recent plan + the 'planner' prompt (all via this.helpers.httpRequest so PostgREST arrays don't fan out), fills the prompt, calls Anthropic, parses the JSON array, and upserts fb_content_plan (status='planned', on_conflict=plan_date do nothing). One GroupMe message (Execute Once). The plan is human-reviewed on the calendar before any generation.

Replace `YOUR_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` and `__...__` placeholders on import. Keep `active:false` in the committed copy.
